archetypes.name: dyn-design-final-summary
archetypes.rationale: Changed /design final-summary prompt contracts and harness pins need deterministic-source review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design final-summary emit changes for source identity, ordering, and render-exit behavior. Check that every collapsed callsite still names the intended source and cites the shared /design row without moving determinism-bearing rules to lazy-read-only context. Verify the harness pins the new compact contract without weakening implement-side summary behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
